text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That award ceremony, too, came far too 
suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Commendation! Congratulations on 
conquering the Summer Sprint Series!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Summary! Curren Chan and her Trainer will 
enter the "Summer Sprint Series"—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Taking 1st place in the Hakodate Sprint 
Stakes, Keeneland Cup, and Centaur 
Stakes—every single one!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She's been crowned the Sprint Queen in 
splendid fashion! She really fired up the 
summer sprint series, didn't she!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Splendid! As Chairwoman of Tracen 
Academy, I hereby express my gratitude and 
high praise for your achievements!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That is all! Award ceremony concluded! 
Everyone, applause!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When you said something good would happen 
if I won the Summer Sprint Series, you 
meant the awards ceremony, didn't you? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is so glad she worked hard♪ I'm 
super happy~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still, if I have the chance...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, could I also ask you a favor while 
we're at it...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Can I take a commemorative picture with 
you, Chairwoman? And please give me 
permission to post it on Umastagram too♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! Publish it wherever you 
wish!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Chairwomaaaan!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay, thank you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, taking the picture now, okay? Say 
cheese♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Halt!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, working the angle a bit more will make 
it pop, you know? For example—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after the award ceremony, Curren 
Chan's lecture on cute posing continued, 
expanding further and further. In the end, 
before we knew it—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Something like that, I suppose? Well 
then~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Please go ahead and prep that project: 
"Umastagrammer Curren Presents♪ A Complete 
Guide to Tracen Academy's Charms"♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! I shall inform Tazuna at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ Looking forward to working with you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Curren will do her very best to make sure 
it's great publicity!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...For both of us, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever resourceful, Curren Chan managed to 
bag a new job on top of everything...
